Creation, reuse, verification, explicit e313-d312 attachment and rehashed-edit rejection passed. Wine drained.
limitations: Controlled interpreter lookups use pre-established index and address registers. Ordinary invocation, broader domains, translated execution, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
